# AI Vision: Gemini Screenshot, Webpage & Multi-Tab AI Assistant for Chrome

> AI Vision is a Chrome extension for asking Google's Gemini API about a selected screenshot, The Tab, or supported tabs in one Chrome window. Its optional Agent Mode can perform constrained browser actions within the user-selected scope.

Canonical website: https://stiwarilbj.github.io/AI_Vision/
Official active Chrome Web Store listing: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ai-vision-gemini-screensh/ghmmlbclopoakmjjbkkmoefjldgjimgk?authuser=0&hl=en

## Primary features

- Capture mode analyzes a user-selected screenshot region.
- Capture is the simple first screen; The Tab, All Tabs, and Agent Mode are optional controls under More modes and tools.
- The Tab mode answers questions about readable content on the current supported webpage.
- All Tabs mode compares up to 20 supported tabs in one Chrome window.
- Response styles include Balanced, Concise, Formal, Casual, Detailed, and Bullet-oriented.
- Agent Mode can be enabled in Capture, The Tab, or All Tabs. Its bundled Google ADK browser runtime rotates one planning request at a time through gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, and gemini-2.5-flash-lite, then repeats. No terminal or companion process is needed.
- Practical guides cover screenshot prompts, webpage summaries, tab comparisons, Agent Mode boundaries, and setup: https://stiwarilbj.github.io/AI_Vision/guides/ai-screenshot-assistant.html
- Webpage summary workflow: https://stiwarilbj.github.io/AI_Vision/guides/summarize-webpage-with-gemini.html
- Multi-tab comparison workflow: https://stiwarilbj.github.io/AI_Vision/guides/compare-chrome-tabs-with-gemini.html
- Reading, waiting, scrolling, and activating an existing in-scope tab can run automatically. Every click, type, direct navigation, new tab, history move, and reload requires approval. Capture and The Tab remain scoped to one tab; All Tabs is optional-permission gated and remains inside the starting Chrome window, subject to permanent safety blocks and a 12-step limit.

## Data handling

- The user supplies a Gemini API key, which is stored by the service worker with preferences in trusted local Chrome storage. The panel receives only masked key status inside a closed Shadow DOM.
- Ordinary and Agent Mode requests go directly to Google's Gemini API over HTTPS from the service worker. The bundled ADK runtime uses the key saved in the extension settings.
- AI Vision has no developer-operated analytics, advertising, tracking, or proxy server.
- The repository is publicly visible but does not currently contain an open-source license.

AI Vision is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
